newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Kinkel to visit Middle East in March.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kinkel to visit Middle East in March.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel will visit Jordan, Israel and the autonomous Palestinian region of Gaza early next month, his ministry said on Monday.

The Foreign Ministry said in a statement that the visit would serve to strengthen Germany's involvement in the Middle East peace process and Europe's role in the region as well as extend economic cooperation with the area.
The ministry said Kinkel would arrive in Amman on March 4 and travel to Jericho and Jerusalem the following day. He would then travel to Gaza on March 6 and end his trip on March 7 in Tel Aviv.
